set.body: Turn the prepared Haxby condition means and VT mask into a small, provenance-complete, offline example object instead of requiring users to run expert scripts or mistake a generated fixture for empirical data. Acceptance: 12 named run-by-condition matrices, stable feature/coordinate identities, VT mask, source citation and license, checksum and regeneration script, explicit preprocessing/normalization ledger, package-size review, a no-network smoke test, and one question-first vignette that reaches contrast, RDM, fixed linear RSA, and a clearly bounded uncertainty example through public APIs.
set.title: Ship a prepared empirical Haxby object for the first real-data journey
